vi_context: Đừng dùng tên shop như tín hiệu chất lượng duy nhất. Hãy đánh giá từng listing bằng ảnh cận, vật liệu, số đo, construction và chính sách đổi trả. Nếu đang xây tủ đồ Alt, xem thêm cách mua sắm Alt Fashion .
en_before: Do not rely on a shop name alone. Assess each listing through close views, material information, measurements, construction and current terms. For the wider wardrobe purchase, see alternative-fashion shopping.
en_after: A shop name alone cannot establish the quality of its leather jackets. Assess each listing through material details, close views, measurements, construction and the current exchange terms. If the purchase belongs to a wider wardrobe plan, use the Alt Fashion buying priorities to decide its role before ordering.
